Glossary
Cachexia Loss of weight, and fat and muscle mass, caused by disease and loss of appetite in people who are not trying to lose
weight.
Enteral feeding Delivery of nutrients, in the form of special solutions, to the stomach or small intestine through a tube, i.e.
‘tube-feeding’.
Nosocomial pneumonia Pneumonia contracted while in hospital, 2–3 days after admission.
Parenteral nutrition Delivery of nutrients through a tube inserted into a vein, because the intestine is nonfunctional.
Pathogmonomic Characteristic or diagnostic of a speciﬁc disease.
